name: Canyon Transit with Relay
summary: Move a team through a canyon with no line of sight to base while keeping a relay alive above the rim.
objective: Transit {corridor} with {transit_uavs} UAVs while one relay stays above the rim so the base keeps a link at RSSI >= {min_rssi_dbm} dBm for the whole transit.
brief: Fly {transit_uavs} UAVs through {corridor} in a {formation} formation. The canyon walls block the link to base, so one UAV must stay above the rim at {relay_alt_m} m as a relay for the whole transit and keep the link at {min_rssi_dbm} dBm or better. If the relay drops below the required link quality, the transit must pause until it is restored.

actions: assign the relay UAV and its orbit above the rim
relay climbs to {relay_alt_m} m and declares link up

checkpoints.name: Relay link
checkpoints.metric: fraction of the transit with RSSI >= {min_rssi_dbm} dBm

checkpoints.name: Transit completion
checkpoints.metric: time to move all transit UAVs through {corridor}

checkpoints.name: Pause discipline
checkpoints.metric: transits continued while the link was below the floor
checkpoints.target: 0 corridor metres flown below the link floor

checkpoints.name: Recovery
checkpoints.target: all on ground, no hard landing

failure_conditions: relay leaves its orbit during the transit
transit continues with no link for more than 20 s
constraints: transit speed <= 8 m/s inside the canyon
grading: global checkpoint pass rate; checkpoint weights sum to 100
